title: The Creative Cure: How Finding and Freeing Your Inner Artist Can Heal Your Life (Hierophan
description: “I’m just not that creative” is a common refrain in today’s society. But according to author and creative coach Jacob Nordby, nothing could be further from the truth. Every human being is creative, and having a regular creative practice is a vital key to a happy and fulfilling life. If we don't exercise our creativity regularly, our lives can feel dull, stagnant, and rote. Many people live this way and believe “this is just the way life is,” without realizing that developing a regular creative practice can be the cure to what ails them. Nordby knows this all too well. By the time he reached his midthirties, he was running a successful mortgage company and lived in a big house with fancy cars. But he felt like he was dying inside. Starting and maintaining a creative practice is what saved his life. Now, in this powerful book, he explains how he traded in his stagnant way of life for one full of meaning and purpose, and offers specific steps to help you build your own creative practice. The Creative Cure is a call for a revolution, fostering change where all change must begin: within. This internal change will allow you to express your own creative gifts, cultivate happiness, and experience the unique feeling of fulfillment that only a creative practice can offer. title: Awakening Creativity: A Sacred Journey to Reclaim Your Inner Artist (Hierophant Creative H
description: Have you ever longed to express yourself creatively, only to be stopped by self-doubt? For many of us, the words of a dismissive teacher, a skeptical loved one, or our own judgmental thoughts have slowly turned art into a performance, leaving the joy of creation behind. As a result, we internalized that creativity must justify itself—measured by praise, practicality, or perfection. In this transformative guide, artist and creativity coach Carrie Schmitt leads you through nine sacred “temples”—each one a sanctuary for healing the wounds that have kept you from your creative birthright. Here, you’ll explore tender reflections, soulful rituals, and liberating practices designed to dissolve perfectionism, quiet the inner critic, and reignite your relationship with Creativity as a sacred, flowing force—not something you have, but something you are. Along the way, you’ll craft a personal guidebook filled with revelations, blessings, and artwork—a living testament to your unfolding journey. With each step, you’ll remember what your soul has always known: Creativity is not a skill to master, but a spirit to embrace. And it has never stopped calling your name.  if(window.mix_csa){window.mix_csa('[cel_widget_id="tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_4"]', '#CardInstanceDRLxjYWQDh6re_ympULpAw')('mark', 'bb')} if(window.uet){window.uet('bb','tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_4',{wb: 1})} ._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_icon_core_report__Fs1ah{color:#0f1111;color:var(--aok-sfs-color-page-primary-normal-fg,#0f1111);display:inline-block;-webkit-filter:none;filter:none;-webkit-filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);height:20px;margin-right:4px;width:20px}._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_

title: Unleash Your Inner Creative Genius: Master Creative Thinking, Spark imagination, Transcend
description: Unleash Your Inner Creative Genius is a captivating book that delves into the science behind creativity and provides readers with practical tips, exercises, and insights to unlock their own creative potential. Written by Girendra Nath Singh, a passionate reader, life student, and researcher of human psychology, this book aims to inspire individuals to make small daily changes that yield remarkable results. ★In this book, you will embark on an exciting journey, discovering how to think faster, smarter, and more creatively. Whether you are a student, employee, professional, or entrepreneur, you will learn how to design your environment, adopt creativity routines, and follow in the footsteps of the world's brightest minds to transform your thinking and predict the future. Key highlights of the book include : Understanding the workings of your brain, leveraging the logical left brain and imaginative right brain to achieve more with less effort. Creating a creative thinking environment and establishing daily habits that supercharge your creativity. Drawing inspiration from renowned creative thinkers such as Leonardo da Vinci, Ray Kroc, Maya Angelou, J.K. Rowling, Oprah Winfrey, Michael Phelps, Pablo Picasso, Thomas Edison, Steve Jobs, Elon Musk, and Albert Einstein , and exploring the creative techniques they used to generate innovative ideas and make insightful observations. Mastering 51 key ideas for personal creative transformations that activate your brain and generate a storm of ideas. This handbook provides practical tools that can be implemented immediately, allowing you to tap into your innate creative potential. Say goodbye to burying your most brilliant ideas in your mind and take the first step towards building your idea treasure by clicking the BUY BUTTON above.

title: Supercharged Creativity: Unleashing Your Inner Creative! (Supercharged Productivity Series
description: Who Should Read This Book? Anyone Looking for Inspiration : Wondering how to get started with creative thinking? Do you know you have great ideas but aren’t entirely sure how to access them? In Chapter 1, you’ll immediately get some great tips for setting aside time and putting yourself in a creative “space” no matter where you are. Anyone Who Wants to Be Creative, but Doesn’t Have the Time : Feel like you just never have enough time to sit down and pursue your ideas? In Chapter 1 and 2, we offer some excellent practical advice on how to create in chaos and how to quickly tune into your creative self. And in Chapter 4 we give you some great methods for building creative renewal into your day. Anyone Who’s Trying to Get Past Creative Roadblocks : When you try to be creative, does the very idea overwhelm you to the point where you don’t know where to begin? In Chapter 4 we give you practical, straight-forward tips for getting past your creative blocks and how to get down to creative problem-solving. We even provide a bonus chapter of exercises, tools and games if you get stuck! Then this straightforward, action-oriented 2-hour guide is designed for you! We all have an inner creative, but sometimes it can be really hard to access that part of ourselves. In this Book You’ll Learn: » How to lay the groundwork for Creative Practice anytime, anywhere! » How to make an impact with your creative ideas » How fear and making mistakes actually helps the creative process » Tons of ideas, exercises and tools to help supercharge your creativity! title: The Creative Act: A Way of Being
description: The #1 New York Times bestseller. "A gorgeous and inspiring work of art on creation, creativity, the work of the artist. It will gladden the hearts of writers and artists everywhere, and get them working again with a new sense of meaning and direction. A stunning accomplishment.” —Anne Lamott From the legendary music producer, a master at helping people connect with the wellsprings of their creativity, comes a beautifully crafted book many years in the making that offers that same deep wisdom to all of us. “ I set out to write a book about what to do to make a great work of art. Instead, it revealed itself to be a book on how to be.” —Rick Rubin Many famed music producers are known for a particular sound that has its day. Rick Rubin is known for something else: creating a space where artists of all different genres and traditions can home in on who they really are and what they really offer. He has made a practice of helping people transcend their self-imposed expectations in order to reconnect with a state of innocence from which the surprising becomes inevitable. Over the years, as he has thought deeply about where creativity comes from and where it doesn’t, he has learned that being an artist isn’t about your specific output, it’s about your relationship to the world. Creativity has a place in everyone’s life, and everyone can make that place larger. In fact, there are few more important responsibilities. The Creative Act is a beautiful and generous course of study that illuminates the path of the artist as a road we all can follow. title: Creative Rush: A New Way to Connect to an Endless Source of Creativity and Overcome Your I
description: Stop Thinking. Start Creating. Reconnect with Your "Knowing Self" in 10 Minutes a Day. You want to create, but something is holding you back. Instead of fighting your blocks, Dushy invites you to bypass the "Thinking Self" entirely and tap into the "Knowing Self" —that intuitive force that already knows exactly what to do. Inside, you will discover how to: Create Without Thinking: Learn the art of Wei Wu (effortless action) to let your hands lead while your mind rests. Silencing the "Grandiose Self": Understand why the pursuit of "greatness" is actually a trap, and how simplicity leads to your best work. Embrace the "Mistake": Shift your perspective to see errors not as failures, but as the universe inviting you to a new path. Build a Sacred Ritual: Turn your workspace into a nourishing environment that triggers flow the moment you enter. Whether you are a painter staring at a blank canvas, a writer facing an empty page, or anyone seeking to live more creatively, this book provides the permission slip you’ve been waiting for. title: The Inner Game Of Creativity: Unearth Your Authentic Creative Drive
description: Are you a creative soul feeling adrift, battling burnout, or struggling to translate your deepest ideas into tangible impact? Many artists, writers, and innovators find themselves trapped in a cycle of unfulfilled potential, constantly seeking external validation or chasing superficial goals that leave them feeling empty. The quiet whispers of your true creative purpose often get drowned out by the noise of expectation and the relentless pursuit of "what looks good on paper." This disconnect isn't just frustrating; it's a profound cost, leading to procrastination, comparison, and a pervasive sense of emptiness, even when you achieve what you set out to do. When you consistently override your intuitive nudges with external pressures, you teach yourself to disconnect, losing trust in your unique path. "The Inner Game Of Creativity: Unearth Your Authentic Creative Drive" offers a transformative journey back to the heart of your creative power. This isn't about quick fixes or external hacks; it's about cultivating an unshakeable inner foundation that fuels sustained, authentic expression. Drawing on the profound wisdom of your intuition and the untapped potential of your subconscious, this book guides you to identify and nurture the true "why" behind your creative endeavors—the intrinsic drive that remains resilient even when the path gets rough and external rewards are slow to materialize. Discover how to silence the external noise and tune into your inner compass, transforming vague discontent into clear, purposeful action. Learn to program your mind for creative success, navigate the inevitable plateaus and learning ruts with grace, and move from mere ideas to impactful, meaningful creations that truly resonate with your authentic self and your audience.
